rules.name: SQL Injection
rules.fp_notes: Often triggered by HTTP 500 on type errors; confirm driver error or boolean difference.

rules.name: SQL Injection - SQLite
rules.fp_notes: Time-based variant; verify delay is reproducible.

rules.name: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
rules.fp_notes: Check that payload is not encoded and response is text/html.

rules.name: Cross Site Scripting (Persistent)
rules.fp_notes: Confirm stored payload executes on a later page.

rules.name: Path Traversal
rules.fp_notes: SPA catch-all routes return 200 for any path.

rules.name: Remote OS Command Injection
rules.fp_notes: Time-based detection sensitive to load on target VM.

rules.name: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
rules.fp_notes: Frequently reported on search/login forms and token-authenticated APIs.

rules.name: Application Error Disclosure
rules.fp_notes: Matches words like 'error' in normal content.

rules.name: Server Leaks Version Information via Server header
rules.fp_notes: Low impact; confirm exact version is exposed.

rules.name: Server Leaks Information via X-Powered-By
rules.fp_notes: Low impact.

rules.name: Timestamp Disclosure - Unix
rules.fp_notes: Very high false-positive rate on numeric constants inside JS bundles.

rules.name: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
rules.fp_notes: Keyword match on minified vendor JS (select, from, user, admin).

rules.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
rules.fp_notes: Only relevant for HTML documents.

rules.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
rules.fp_notes: Reported on every static file; deduplicate.

rules.name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
rules.fp_notes: Irrelevant for images, JSON, fonts.

rules.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
rules.fp_notes: Only applies to HTTPS responses.

rules.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
rules.fp_notes: Check whether the cookie is a session cookie.

rules.name: Cookie without SameSite Attribute
rules.fp_notes: Check whether the cookie is a session cookie.

rules.name: Source Code Disclosure - /WEB-INF folder
rules.fp_notes: Confirm real file content.

rules.name: Hidden File Found
rules.fp_notes: SPA fallback produces 200 for hidden names.
